generated one. Other documents REFERENCE this file, or say nothing.
ONE-TRUTH-1 made 19 copies machine-written and machine-checked. That was the wrong shape: a
generated copy is still a copy, it still has to be kept in step, and a reader who finds one has
no way to know whether it is the truth or a stale rendering of it. ONE-TRUTH-2 (the owner's
order) deleted all 19. Where a document's argument needed the reader to know a fingerprint
EXISTS, it now points here; where it did not, the mention was removed.
WHERE A CURRENT VALUE MAY STILL APPEAR, and nowhere else:
- this file
- docs/TAGS.md — the tag register. A tag's hash is what it was when the tag was cut.
- reports/ — the lab journal. Append-only by rule: a report records what was true on the day
it was written and must never be rewritten. Listed as a PREFIX rather than 112 filenames,
which is a decision: enumerating them would be noise that nobody would maintain, and the
append-only rule already makes every one of them history by construction.
TO RE-MINT: run the role's `reproduce` command, put the new value here, and commit. There is
nothing else to update — that is the point.
WHICH DOCUMENT OWNS WHAT, resolved because four of them implied they owned this:
- THIS FILE owns the CURRENT VALUES. Nothing else does.
- docs/SIM.md owns the LINEAGE — which change moved which value to which. Its head points here.
- reports/parity/REBASELINE.md owns WHAT MOVED each one, and now carries no values.
- docs/SHIP-CEREMONY.md owns the PROCEDURE for minting.

camera.mintedBy: FINISH-PAIR-1 — the photo finish frames the pair it is actually FOLLOWING. The shot captures its two contenders once at entry; the framing guaranteed the live top two by `t`, re-sorted over the whole field every frame with no finished filter. Finished racers do not stop — raceCore coasts them on a run-out decay, and a later finisher carries a fresher decay than an earlier one, so it overtakes — and the guaranteed second slot walked backwards through the finishing order while the shot was still running. Every swap moved the pair distance discontinuously, the guarantee ceiling jumped, the binding zoom authority flipped between guarantee and state, and the picture lurched. Owner: 'da ist jetzt wirklich was kaputt'. MEASURED on his race (Searound, 20 racers, seed 2814): reversals of the picture worth >= 60 screen px 5 -> 2, Mountainstreet 4 -> 2, River Run 4 -> 2, no change on the six other measurable tracks; one swing had cost 1063 screen px in SIX frames. It does not cost a cropped winner, measured the other way round: the eventual winner is in frame for 100% of the shot against 87-91% before, and on River Run the live pair had lost its OWN contenders off-frame for 93-98% of it. MEASURED FRESH ON 36e475ea, the tree the owner judged on production ('wir springen nicht mehr wild herum mit der Kamera, das ist gut'). Replaces afd7461071cf2eec (CEREMONY-OPENING).
